title: From Brown to Green? The Displacement Effect of Coal-fired Power Plant Closures in China
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper examines the displacement of air pollution after retiring coal-fired power plants, and market factors to reduce these displacement effects. We exploit the mass closures of coal-fired plants and simultaneous development of renewable energy in China from 2004 to 2014 as a quasi-natural experiment, combining geographic and operational information from more than 1500 power plants with high resolution satellite data measuring monthly sulphur dioxide ( ) levels. Our difference-in-difference estimates indicate that, while levels are 2.3% lower in areas surrounding closed coal-fired power plants, areas surrounding nearby active coal-fired ones suffer from 1.7% spike in . Reducing inter-provincial trade barriers and promoting greener alternative energy sources are evident to mitigate this displacement effect. A back-of-the-envelope calculation shows that the two policy tools can decrease net annual emissions by 0.18 to 0.27 million tons, approximately 3.7 to 5.6 times of the baseline case without these interventions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了退役燃煤电厂后大气污染的转移效应，以及降低这些转移效应的市场因素。我们利用2004年至2014年中国大规模关停燃煤电厂并同步发展可再生能源这一事件作为准自然实验，将1,500多座电厂的地理和运营信息，与测量月度二氧化硫（SO2）浓度的高分辨率卫星数据相结合。我们的双重差分估计表明，在关停的燃煤电厂周边地区，SO2水平降低了2.3%，而附近仍在运行的燃煤电厂周边地区则出现了1.7%的SO2上升。减少省际贸易壁垒和推广更清洁的替代能源，显然可以减缓这种转移效应。粗略计算表明，这两项政策工具可使年净排放减少0.18至0.27百万吨，约为不采取这些干预措施的基准情形的3.7至5.6倍。

Accident Externality of Driving: Evidence from the London Congestion Charge
abstract: This paper estimates the marginal accident externality of driving in Central London by exploiting variation in traffic flow induced by the London Congestion Charge Zone using an instrumental variable approach. The charge attributed to a 9.4% reduction in traffic flow, which resulted in a less than proportional 6.0% and 7.6% decrease in accidents and slight injuries, and a 6.5% increase in serious injuries/fatalities. Our preferred estimates indicate that the accident, slight injuries, and serious injuries/fatalities rate elasticities with respect to traffic flow are -0.36, -0.19 and -1.65 respectively. These estimates imply that the marginal external benefit of road safety from an additional kilometre driven is approximately £ 0.16. The marginal accident externality is positive, as the marginal driver along congested roads decreases the risk and severity of traffic collisions for other road users by slowing others down and increasing awareness.
abstract_zh: 本文利用伦敦市中心拥堵收费区所引起的交通流量变化，采用工具变量方法估计了市中心驾驶的边际事故外部性。收费使交通流量减少了9.4%，相应地，事故数量和轻伤人数分别减少了6.0%和7.6%（降幅低于交通流量的降幅），而严重伤亡人数则增加了6.5%。我们偏好的估计表明，事故、轻伤和严重伤亡/死亡率相对于交通流量的弹性分别为−0.36、−0.19和−1.65。这些估计意味着，每多开一公里所带来的道路安全边际外部收益约为0.16英镑。边际事故外部性为正，因为在拥堵道路上，边际驾驶者通过减速以及提高他人的警觉性，降低了其他道路使用者遭遇交通碰撞的风险和严重程度。

title: Covid-19 restriction policies and shopping streets
The Cost of Traffic: Evidence from the London Congestion Charge
abstract: This paper exploits the implementation of the London Congestion Charge (LCC) to provide credible estimates on the willingness to pay to avoid traffic using the housing market. This policy curtails road traffic by imposing a fee on anyone driving into the charge zone. My results show that the LCC is associated with significant improvement in traffic conditions and housing values. Instrumenting local traffic conditions with the enforcement of the LCC, and limiting the analysis to properties proximate to the charge boundary, I find that the elasticity of housing values with respect to traffic is -0.30. These findings suggest that the consequential improvement in traffic conditions due to the LCC has generated substantial windfall of more than £3.8 billion for homeowners in the zone.
abstract_zh: 本文利用伦敦拥堵收费（LCC）的实施，通过住房市场提供了关于人们为避免交通而愿意支付金额的可信估计。该政策对任何驶入收费区的人征收费用，从而抑制道路交通。我的结果表明，LCC与交通状况和住房价值的显著改善相关。以LCC的执行情况作为当地交通状况的工具变量，并将分析限于靠近收费边界的房产，我发现住房价值相对于交通的弹性为−0.30。这些发现表明，LCC带来的交通状况改善，为该区域的房主创造了超过38亿英镑的可观意外之财。
